# CV-12 — Replies and Wrap up

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-12-replies` · head: see the hand-back · status: built, not landed
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016120000_chat_v2_chains.sql` (provisional stamp, after `…_chat_v2_reactions`) · applied to the local stack: yes

## Delivered against the row

- **Server** (`…_chat_v2_chains.sql`): the root keeps `wrapped_at` / `wrapped_by` / `settled_id` and the last reopen `reopened_at` / `reopened_by` (CHECK: only a root is wrapped; a settled reply needs a wrap). Ops `chat_op_wrap_up(root, settled_id, mark_decision default false)` (`mark_decision` is accepted and logged; CV-14 stores the decision), `chat_op_reopen(root)`, `chat_op_attach_to_chain(message, reply_to_id)` ("Reply to…"), `chat_op_chain_read(root)`. Who may wrap up or reopen: the root's author (who can post), the channel's managers, admins, anyone who can post in a direct message; never a viewer; never in an archived channel. `chat_op_send` (from its live body) reopens a wrapped chain when a reply arrives ("Reopened by <sender>"); nothing else changed in it. `chat__close_read` (from its live body) no longer closes Catch up items of replies hidden by a wrap-up; `chat_op_chain_read` closes them when the chain is read on the right. Activity rows `chat.wrap_up`, `chat.reopen`. Index `chat_messages_chains_idx (channel_id, last_reply_at desc) where reply_count > 0 and deleted_at is null`; `(parent_id, created_at, id)` kept. Grants restated by name: ops for `authenticated` + `service_role`, helpers `service_role` only, nothing for `anon` / PUBLIC (asserted per function in the test).
- **Stream**: Reply (hover, ⋯, `R`) puts "Replying to **Name** · excerpt ×" above the main composer (Esc or × clears it); the reply posts at the bottom with one muted quote line; clicking the quote jumps to the quoted message (or opens its chain when the chain is wrapped). The root shows "N replies · Alex, Mike ›" with avatars, "· Reopened by Mike" after a reopen, and "✓ Wrapped up by Sofia: Jana "Got them…" · 4 replies ›" when wrapped. Replies of a wrapped root leave the stream (a drawing rule in `timeline.ts` `wrappedReplyIds`, through the stream's hidden set). ⋯ gains Wrap up (roots with replies) and Reply to…. ⏎ on a message with replies opens its chain.
- **The chain item** (`panel/chain-item.tsx`): "← Reply chain", Wrap up / Reopen in the title row, "Sofia, Alex · You're following · Stop" (`chat_op_follow_chain`), the root, "N replies", the replies in order ("✓ Settled it" on the settling reply), its own box "Reply to Sofia" (⏎ replies, Esc in the empty box goes back). Opening it reads the chain (`chat_op_chain_read`). Opened from "N replies ›", the Reply chains view, Details and the `t` link.
- **Wrap up** (`dialogs/chain-dialogs.tsx`): "Which reply settled it?" with the chain's replies (the last one preselected); then "Wrapped up · Undo" for 8 s. **Reply to…**: a dialog of this conversation's earlier messages (open chains first) with a filter.
- **Reply chains view** (`panel/reply-chains-view.tsx`, the panel's second view, ⌥2; the "Details ▾" switcher now appears): open chains newest activity first with "N replies · last 2:40 PM · 1 new", then "Wrapped up" with "✓ Jana "…" · yesterday". **Details' Reply chains** section shows the same, compact. One read (`panel/use-reply-chains.ts`, a plain select of roots with replies, up to 100).
- Nothing folds automatically.

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **Reply from the main box shows "Replying to Name · excerpt" until sent or Esc** · agent · rounds 2–3 drew it and §16's Esc order names "reply quote" · rejected: Reply opening the chain (that's "N replies ›").
- **Unread replies a wrap-up hides stay in Catch up until the chain is read** · agent · the read mark is what was on screen (§6 #17), and the edge case says they stay; a new `chat_op_chain_read` closes them when the chain opens · rejected: letting the stream's read mark close them (they'd vanish unseen).
- **The toast's Undo leaves no "Reopened by" line** · agent · a reopen by the person who wrapped it within 10 s is the Undo (the toast is 8 s) · rejected: "Reopened by you" after every Undo. Known: an Undo also drops an earlier "Reopened by" line.
- **Reply to… onto a wrapped chain reopens it; moving a settling reply out reopens the chain it left; a new quote inside the same chain doesn't** · agent · CH54 (a new reply reopens) and the settling reply always belongs to its chain · rejected: refusing.
- **Reply to… lists only earlier messages; a message with replies of its own can't join another chain** · agent · one level (#23), and a reply answers what came before · rejected: re-parenting whole chains (that's Move to…, CV-16).
- **No "Also mark as decision" box yet** · agent · the brief: the tick arrives with CV-14; `p_mark_decision` is already in the op · rejected: a box that does nothing.
- **"N new" in Reply chains counts held replies by others after your read mark (at least 1 when the last reply is newer and not yours)** · agent · no server count exists; one plain select · rejected: a read RPC for one number.
- **Wrap up may happen on a deleted root with replies** · agent · a deleted root keeps its chain · rejected: refusing.
- **A deleted settling reply keeps the wrap-up**, which then reads "Deleted message" · agent · delete has an Undo and shouldn't silently reopen a chain · rejected: reopening on delete.
- **Inside the chain, a quote shows only when a reply quotes another reply** · agent (sub-builder) · quoting the root again is noise.
- **`R` without the right to post opens the chain** · agent (sub-builder) · readers keep a useful R.
- **A reply posted after the wrap time always shows** while the reopened root is on its way · agent (sub-builder).
- **The read mark passes hidden replies at the end of the stream** (when everything after the last drawn row is a wrapped chain's reply) · agent · otherwise a conversation whose newest messages are wrapped replies stays unread forever; their Catch up items still stay open until the chain is read (`chat__close_read`) · rejected: leaving the mark on the last drawn row.
- **Wrap up / Reply to… mirror the server's rule**: your role must post (managers too); a listed manager manages only while a member; "Manage any channel" works from outside a public channel · agent · the ops decide, the menu shouldn't offer what they refuse · known: someone removed from a public channel still sees them on their own messages (the client has no "removed" signal) and gets the refusal.
- **A chain link's `t` leaves the address once the chain is open** · agent · so the next link to the same chain opens it again.
- **The quote line keeps CV-7a's arrow and full name** (the frame draws a small avatar and first name) · agent · one quote grammar already shipped · revisit in polish.

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- Db tests run in one transaction, so every `now()` is the same: chain order tests must stamp `created_at` themselves (`chat_chains.test.sql`'s `test.post`).
- `chat__enter` (rejoin) uses `chat__close_read`: items of replies hidden in a wrapped chain now stay open after a rejoin too.

## Known, left for later

- The Catch up badge can dip to 0 for a moment when the read mark passes hidden replies (`markSeen` zeroes the counts; the next counts read restores it). CV-11 (Catch up) owns the counts.
- Clicking the same chain notice twice reopens the chain but doesn't scroll back to its reply (the same as plain `m` links before).
- A role with "Manage any channel" but no post right doesn't see Reply to… on others' messages, though the op would allow it (the safe direction).
- An Undo can leave "undid a wrap-up" out of Details' history until the next change (the same pattern pins have).

- `chat_op_agent_post` replies don't reopen a wrapped chain (agents block).
